metadata.label: Metadata
metadata.description: Add key-value pairs, these can be used for API integrations and also in flows.

allowTakeOver.label: Allow Takeover
allowTakeOver.description: If enabled, the resource can be taken over by other users without the current user having to release the resource.

separateUnlockAndUnlatch.label: Separate Unlock and Unlatch
separateUnlockAndUnlatch.description: Can be useful if the door needs to be unlocked and the latch needs to be opened separately

retraining.description: Require users to be retrained after a period of time or inactivity. Leave a field empty to disable that trigger.

maxAgeDays.label: Retrain after (days since training)
maxAgeDays.description: Retraining becomes due this many days after a user was trained, regardless of usage.

maxInactivityDays.label: Retrain after inactivity (days)
maxInactivityDays.description: Retraining becomes due if the user has not used this resource for this many days.

blocksAccess.label: Block access until retrained
blocksAccess.description: If enabled, users lose access once retraining is due until an introducer retrains them.

toast.title: Error Creating Resource
toast.description: Could not create the resource. Please try again.

toast.title: Error Updating Resource
toast.description: Could not update the resource. Please try again.
